img.caption: Fig 3: Calibration quality and refusal behavior. Left: Expected Calibration Error (15-bin, lower is better); right: intra-domain false-reject rate. QP-OneModel miscalibrates heavily on CLINC150 (ECE 0.47) and over-refuses 86% of in-domain queries. CICC and MULACONF never refuse multi-intent queries but are moderately miscalibrated (ECE 0.09-0.28). Ours attains the lowest ECE on CLINC150 (0.005) and MixSNIPS (0.045) while keeping false refusal bounded.
